message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a red vertical border on the left and a red horizontal border at the bottom. At the top, white text reads "TOKOH SENI 2014" above a large, bold white title "TEMPO". Smaller text below it reads "5-11 JANUARI 2015". Centered in the middle is the large white text "HOROR AIRASIA" followed by smaller text: "Benarkah pesawat yang jatuh di Selat Karimata itu tak dilengkapi peta cuaca."

The background is a landscape of dense, dark grey and charcoal storm clouds, depicted with heavy, painterly textures. These clouds occupy most of the frame, swirling downward into a vertical funnel-like shape. A small red and white passenger airplane is positioned in the lower-left quadrant, flying toward the right, dwarfed by the massive cloud formations. The plane's livery is predominantly red with white lettering and stripes. In the bottom right corner, white text indicates "RP 39.500", a website URL, and serial information. A barcode with the number "00045" and a numerical sequence "9 770126 427302" is at the bottom right.
